run_mogmpo_experiment: run the Mixture of Gaussian MPO experiment on a continuous control environment like HalfCheetah
build_experiment_config: build an MPO experiment config with mixture of Gaussians critic for continuous control tasks
configure_mpo_agent: configure an MPO agent builder with Gaussian policy loss and transition-based experience
create_network_factory: create a network factory that builds MPONetworks with configurable policy and critic layer sizes
launch_distributed_experiment: launch a distributed MPO experiment with four actors using LaunchPad XM Docker resources
